svc_speedup.page_desc: We diagnose, optimize, and turbocharge your existing website — dramatically improving Core Web Vitals and Google PageSpeed scores.
svc_speedup.hero_sub: Every 100ms of latency costs revenue. We audit your site, find every bottleneck, and fix them — measurably, verifiably.
svc_speedup.offer_sub: We don't just run a report — we fix every metric that impacts your users and your Google ranking.
svc_speedup.feat_1_desc: LCP, CLS, and INP brought within Google's "Good" thresholds — measured before and after.
svc_speedup.feat_2_desc: WebP conversion, lazy loading, responsive srcsets, and CDN delivery.
svc_speedup.feat_3_desc: JS/CSS bundles reduced, tree-shaken, and deferred so the page renders instantly.
svc_speedup.feat_4_desc: Redis caching, OPcache, query optimization, and server-side response time reduction.
svc_speedup.feat_5_desc: Static asset delivery via CDN so users worldwide get sub-100ms load times.
svc_speedup.feat_6_desc: Slow queries identified, indexes added, N+1 issues eliminated.
svc_speedup.step_1_desc: PageSpeed, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, GTmetrix — we build a complete picture of your bottlenecks.
svc_speedup.step_2_desc: We rank every issue by impact and effort, then share a detailed fix plan for your approval.
svc_speedup.step_3_desc: Fixes implemented on staging first, regression-tested, then deployed to production.
svc_speedup.step_4_desc: Full metrics comparison — PageSpeed scores, Web Vitals, TTFB, load time. In writing.
svc_speedup.pricing_sub: All packages include a before/after report with measured improvements.
svc_speedup.pkg_1_desc: Full audit + prioritized fix plan delivered in 48 hours. Implement yourself or upgrade.
svc_speedup.pkg_2_desc: Audit + full implementation of all identified optimizations with verification report.
svc_speedup.pkg_3_desc: Monthly performance monitoring, regression alerts, and quarterly re-optimization.
svc_speedup.faq_1_q: What PageSpeed score can I expect?
svc_speedup.faq_1_a: Most clients go from 30–50 to 85–95+ on mobile after optimization. We document the exact before/after.
svc_speedup.faq_2_a: No — we always work on a staging copy first, fully test, then deploy to production only after sign-off.
svc_speedup.faq_3_q: Does this work on WordPress sites?
svc_speedup.faq_3_a: Yes. We optimize WordPress, Laravel, Next.js, and any custom stack.
svc_speedup.faq_4_q: How long does the optimization take?
svc_speedup.faq_4_a: Audit in 48 hours, implementation 3–7 days depending on scope.
svc_speedup.cta_sub: Send us your URL and we'll tell you exactly what's slowing you down — free initial assessment.

svc_maintain.faq_3_a: We restore from the last clean backup immediately, then investigate and patch the vulnerability.
